result:
Both `bun run typecheck` and `bun test` pass (10 tests, 0 failures).

I made the excerpt optional end-to-end: `PostPayloadSchema` in `app/Http/Validators/PostValidator.ts` now declares `excerpt` as a trimmed, optional string capped at 500 characters (title and body validation are untouched, so blanks there still 422), and I regenerated `.guren/api-client.gen.ts` so the `posts.store`/`posts.update` body types carry `excerpt?: string`. The derivation lives in a new pure module `app/Support/excerpt.ts`: `deriveExcerpt(body)` trims the body, returns it whole when it is 140 characters or fewer, otherwise keeps the first 140 characters, cuts back to the last whitespace only when characters 140 and 141 are both non-whitespace (leaving an unbroken 140-character run cut at 140), trims trailing whitespace and appends the single `…` character; `resolveExcerpt(excerpt, body)` prefers a non-empty typed excerpt and falls back to the derived one. `PostController.store()` and `PostController.update()` both call `resolveExcerpt` and store the result, so an update that leaves the field blank re-derives from the new body. Both forms (`resources/js/pages/posts/New.tsx` and `Edit.tsx`) now label the field "Excerpt (optional)" with a placeholder explaining the fallback and tolerate an undefined value, and `tests/excerpt.test.ts` covers the rule including the two worked examples from the request.
